overview.headline: Comparing physical and orbital properties of solar system worlds

keyPoints.point: Students learn that orbital period grows longer for worlds farther from the Sun.
Students learn that mean temperature generally decreases for outer worlds.
Students learn that surface pressure varies widely across different worlds.
keyPoints.quote: | Surface Pressure (bars) | 0 | 92 | 1 | 0 | 0.01 | Unknown* | Unknown* | Unknown* | Unknown* | 0.00001 |

keyPoints.point: Students learn that a global magnetic field is present for some worlds and absent for others.
keyPoints.quote: | Global Magnetic Field? | Yes | No | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Unknown |

keyTerms.gloss: Time needed for a world to complete one orbital journey around the Sun
